entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this useless VeloBand sensor. I want my money back, and I want it now. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter why! I just want to return it. Don't you dare tell me it's **too late** or try to feed me some line about **hygiene** and **sanitation**. I've barely even touched the thing.
I understand your frustration, sir. I just need to pull up your account to check the details. Could you please provide me with your order number?
I don't have the order number! Use my email, it's angrycustomer@email.com. And if you don't fix this in the next two minutes, I want your manager. I'm already writing a one-star review as we speak.
Thank you for that. One moment while I pull it up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like it was delivered on December 24th, which was 14 days ago.
And? Are you going to do something or just state the obvious?
Yes, absolutely. According to our return **policy** for this specific product, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund. I can approve this return for you immediately.
Wait, really? So you're just... going to give me my money back?

That's correct. I've just processed the return authorization and emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Oh. Okay. Well... that's... fine, then. I'll get the email with the label?
Yes, it should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
